practiceReport.name: Brock Bowers
practiceReport.archetypeNote: High-snap focal-point tight end with high active conversion on minor mid-week tags.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Bowers "was not ready to play" against Denver, per Kubiak, but the head coach believes Vegas' star tight end could be ready to return in Week 12 against the Browns on SNF. Bowers was held to 18 yards by the Seahawks during Fernando Mendoza's first regular-season start in Week 10 after mustering at least 70 receiving yards in each of his seven games with Kirk Cousins.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (81%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Keenan went down with a knee injury in the first half, and he will now officially be sidelined for the rest of Week 11. With Adam Butler (concussion) also done for the day, JJ Pegues will handle the bulk of the workload at defensive tackle versus the Broncos.

practiceReport.name: Kwity Paye
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Paye made an early exit in the second half of Sunday's loss to the Seahawks with a neck injury. The linebacker did not return to the contest, but the issue does not seem to have been serious. Paye is healthy and appears ready to log consistent full practices throughout Week 11 prep.

practiceReport.name: Michael Mayer
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (80% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Mayer missed out on a prime opportunity with top TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) inactive in Week 11. When Bowers was out in Weeks 1 and 2 as he recovered from a meniscus trim in his left knee, Mayer went for a combined 9-55-0 line on 11 targets in those contests, but the latter also missed a stretch in the fourth quarter this Sunday due to a back injury. Bowers' status will be worth monitoring this week, as an absence from him next Sunday in Cleveland will set up Mayer for another key chance to produce.

practiceReport.name: Thomas Booker IV
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Beat/podium consensus: on track to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: An ankle injury has sidelined Booker for each of the Raiders' last two games. However, his full session Wednesday indicates that he's recovered from his injury and on track to play in Sunday's AFC West tilt against the Broncos. Booker has accumulated 13 tackles (nine solo) across seven regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Matt Gay
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Gay sandwiched two limited practices this week around Thursday's DNP due to a right hip injury and entered the weekend listed as questionable for Sunday. Because the Raiders didn't elevate Kansei Matsuzawa from the practice squad Saturday, it was an indication that Gay was good to go for Week 11, which now has been confirmed. In 10 games this season, Gay has connected on 21 of 23 field-goal attempts and all 22 point-after tries.

practiceReport.name: Folorunso Fatukasi
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Fatukasi was tagged as questionable due to a toe injury, although he ended Week 11 prep with a full practice Friday, and he's now been cleared by medical staff to play Sunday. The veteran defensive lineman has 16 tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks, one pass defense and one forced fumble through 10 regular-season games.
